entries.complaint: Translating AND to a single Croatian letter (I) is grammatically correct but risks visual confusion with other single characters typed into a compact query field; I used it because es/ru precedent in this file already translates the keyword fully, but flagging since it's a judgment call with no glossary guidance for this specific pair.
readings: I / ILI (fully translated, matches es/ru precedent)
AND / OR (left as literal keywords, matches it/cs precedent)

entries.complaint: EPANET 'tag' (a per-asset metadata field) has no glossary entry, and the natural Croatian translation of 'tag' is 'oznaka' -- the exact word already firmly established in this file for the page's own 'Label' concept (map labels). Using 'oznaka' for EPANET tags would collide with that established sense, so I kept the English loanword 'tag' instead, consistent with other kept technical loanwords (ID, DEM) in this file.
readings: oznaka (natural translation, but collides with the page's Label concept)
